title: Tower Guard
description: Build towers along the winding path to stop the waves of slimes from reaching your castle. Upgrade your towers and survive all 20 waves!
instructions: Click or tap an empty grass tile to build the selected tower.
Click a tower to upgrade or sell it.
Keyboard: 1–3 pick a tower, arrow keys move the cursor, B builds, S sells, Space sends the next wave.
Don't let 20 slimes reach the castle.
